q1_issues.issue: sk_number_1 is typed as `number` but never linked to the households or their counts, so the of-phrase argument of "the number of households acquiring music" is dropped and the Patient of the falling event is a dangling entity.
Source is filled with the April household GROUP rather than the numeric level 14.5 million that the falling actually starts from — a group of households is not a value on the scale that fell.

Goal is filled with the June household group only, dropping the coordinated "to 12.7 million in May AND 10.4 million in June" — one of the two coordinated endpoints is lost, and again a group stands where a value belongs.
(Member npd company) asserts a kind the text never states — "according to NPD" supplies no kind word, so no words put this atom there.

(More quantity ...) invents a comparative the sentence does not contain and uses `quantity` as a scale, where the instruction set's quantity comparative uses the surface poles few/many and requires a stated comparative.
Same as statement 30 — a derived May-vs-June ordering asserted as a stated comparative on an unstated `quantity` scale.
(Past sk_acquire_1) (and 12, 19) puts tense on a tenseless reduced-relative participle ("households acquiring music"), which the instruction set's reduced-relative rule does not license.

q2_gaps: "the number of Ns" as a quantity-denoting subject NP — the of-phrase is neither genitive, partitive, measure-of, nor nominalization-object as the instruction set defines them, and no route is given for making the number itself the thing predicated of

change in a measured quantity over time — "fell from a high of 14.5 million in April to 12.7 million in May and 10.4 million in June"; Measure/More/MoreBy all compare entities on a scale, and nothing encodes one quantity moving between successive values
attribution / evidential "according to <source>" — no construction is defined for marking a whole proposition as reported by a source
"a high of N" (a peak value as the source of a decline)
notes: AccordingTo is defensible under the multi-word preposition-named oblique licence, so I did not list it, though attribution as a construction is uncovered. The three-month decomposition into three groups with Cardinality atoms is a reasonable restructuring; the damage is concentrated in the fall event, whose Patient, Source and Goal are all mis-filled.
